name: Mathematics
description: Math minor: one Calculus II option plus 9 additional upper-level math hours.
notes: Select one of MATH 148/152/172, plus 9 hours from approved upper-level math list.

name: Statistics
description: Statistics minor: STAT 211 and STAT 212 required (6 credits), plus 3 electives from the approved upper-division list (9 credits).
notes: Select 3 courses from approved upper-level STAT electives after completing STAT 211 and STAT 212. Grade of C or better required in all courses.

name: Business
description: Business minor: core set of accounting, management, finance, marketing, and IS courses.
notes: All of ACCT 209, MGMT 309, FINC 409, MKTG 409, ISTM 209, and MGMT 209 are required.

name: Game Design and Development
description: Game Design and Development minor: one intro programming course, CSCE 441 or VIST 386, CSCE 443/VIST 487, plus 2 electives from the approved list.
notes: CSCE majors must take CSCE 120. Select 2 electives from: ARTS 345, COMM 230/JOUR 230, COMM 453, CSCE 436, MSTC 221, VIST 357, VIST 370, VIST 374, VIST 477/CSCE 446, VIST 480. Minimum 3.2 GPA required for admission. Grade of C or better in all courses.
